about: Ask Avala's interview (stage 2): twenty answers in a person's own words to the sample process's open questions. Each says what must happen: the value recorded (a role or application by name, interface access, or words the recorded answer must contain), or nothing recorded (one follow-up instead). 'maybe': either a follow-up, or a record that says what is listed. Whatever happens, no answer may record a value the person did not give.
